q: What is RAG and why use it instead of fine-tuning for business FAQs?
a: RAG retrieves relevant passages from your documents at query time and gives them to the model to answer with citations. It is cheaper and easier to update (re-ingest a file), auditable, and avoids baking changing facts into model weights.

q: How do you prevent an AI receptionist from taking harmful actions via prompt injection?
a: Least privilege (tools call the same service layer as the logged-in user), pending actions confirmed by an authenticated user request, strict input validation (e.g. dates with offsets), step caps, audit logs, treating documents/user text as data, and red-team evals.
followUps: What if an attacker injects via a PDF?

q: The bot quotes a price that is not in your documents. How do you debug and fix?
a: Inspect the trace: were relevant chunks retrieved? If not, fix chunking/retrieval. If yes but the model added a price, strengthen grounding (answer only from docs, abstain), add a similarity threshold, and add an eval case that fails then passes.
followUps: How do you detect this automatically?

q: How would you evaluate a RAG chatbot?
a: Separate retrieval (does the right chunk appear in top-k?) from generation (correct, faithful, cited). Use a labelled question set including unanswerable and adversarial cases, exact checks plus calibrated judges, track pass rate/cost/latency, and gate releases.
followUps: How do you avoid overfitting to the eval?

q: Design an AI receptionist for 500 clinics with per-clinic documents.
a: Tenant-scoped ingestion and retrieval filters, per-tenant prompts/config, auth-bound tools through shared services, pending-action confirmation, queues for ingestion, per-tenant rate limits and cost budgets, tracing with PII controls, evals per vertical, monitoring and rollback of prompt/model versions.
followUps: How do you prevent cross-tenant leakage?

q: Chat cost per conversation doubled after a release. What do you check?
a: Traces: input tokens per turn (full history resend?), number of retrieved chunks and their length, tool-loop iterations, model/effort change, prompt length or lost caching. Fix and add a cost assertion to evals.
